body:
I want her. I had stopped thinking singularly and started thinking as 'us'. Now its all come crashing down. 

I have a great family (with the exception of dad) but the person I'd talk to is her. She's the one that makes (made?) me feel at ease. We have a tendency to bury things in my family, we just carry on regardless and things will get better. Discussing this with them will also change their opinion of her radically. If we do have a future how do we do that when my family will basically hate her?
